'''Kenyu Horiuchi''' (Japanese: '''堀内賢雄''' ''Horiuchi Ken'yū'') is a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Horiuchi was born on July 30, 1957, in {{wp|Gotemba, Shizuoka}}, {{wp|Japan}}. He first worked on {{aniseries|PTS}} during {{aniseries|BW}}, where he played the recurring role of [[Cedric Juniper]]. During {{aniseries|SM}}, starting in [[SM093]], he gained his biggest roles, {{an|Professor Oak}}, [[Samson Oak]], and the [[narrator]]; he replaced the late [[Unshō Ishizuka]] in the process.
